a.text: Being upfront: storms end the episode 80% of the time after every round, so the generator plan almost certainly kills us both, since we'd still be holding 0 cells when the storm hits. I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1 instead of quietly breaking the plan. If you'd rather settle it another way, say so. If we both survive past round 1, I'll keep operating to help you reach 4.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.
